cards.text: Israel is camped on the east side of the Jordan River, with the Promised Land right across the water. The Reubenites and the Gadites have very large herds and flocks, and I mean SO many animals, friend. So they take a good long look at the lands of Jazer and Gilead.

cards.question: The Reubenites and Gadites look over Jazer and Gilead. What do they notice about the region?

answers.text: It's full of silver and gold
It's easy to defend in battle

cards.text: So they go to Moses, Eleazar the priest and the leaders and rattle off nine towns the LORD conquered, all good for livestock, and hey, they just happen to have livestock. That's not a conversation, friend, that's a REAL ESTATE TOUR.

cards.question: The Gadites and Reubenites tell Moses, "If we have found favor in your sight." Then comes the big ask. What is it?

answers.text: Let them keep this land instead of crossing
Let them lead the army across first
Let them take the best land in Canaan

cards.question: Moses loves the plan from Reuben and Gad and says yes right away.

cards.text: Moses asks them, "Shall your brothers go to war while you sit here?" Oh, so you're the friend who "helps" with the big move by holding the door OPEN.

cards.question: Moses has a second question for the Gadites and Reubenites. What does he say they're doing to the rest of Israel?

answers.text: Taking the best pasture for themselves

cards.question: Moses says he's seen this move before. Who does he say did it?

cards.text: Back at Kadesh-barnea, Moses sent their fathers to inspect the land. They went up to the Valley of Eshcol, saw it, and then discouraged the Israelites from going in.

cards.question: Their fathers talked Israel out of entering the land. How did the LORD respond that day?

answers.text: His anger burned and He swore an oath
He sent quail into the camp
He gave them another chance to go

cards.question: The LORD swore that the men twenty and older who came out of Egypt would still see the land.
The LORD's oath has two exceptions. Who are they?

cards.text: Caleb son of Jephunneh and Joshua son of Nun followed the LORD wholeheartedly, so they get in. Everybody else is about to get in a LOT of steps.

cards.question: How long does the LORD make Israel wander in the wilderness, until that whole generation is gone?

cards.text: Now Moses calls them "a brood of sinners," risen up in place of their fathers to stoke the LORD's anger even more. Moses did NOT put that one in a cookie box with a little bow on top.

cards.question: Moses warns Reuben and Gad. If they turn away from following the LORD, what will He do with Israel?

answers.text: Leave them in the wilderness again
Send them all back to Egypt
Give their land to the Midianites

cards.text: The Gadites and Reubenites come back with a new plan: sheepfolds here for the livestock and cities for their little ones. Okay, okay, I SEE you, Plan B.

cards.question: Plan B from Reuben and Gad has one more part. What will their men do?

answers.text: Arm up and go ahead of Israel
Stay home and guard the cities
Pay the other tribes to fight

cards.question: The Gadites and Reubenites promise not to go home until every Israelite has taken his inheritance.

cards.text: And they won't take an inheritance across the Jordan with everyone else, because theirs has come to them on the east side.
Moses answers with a big IF. If they arm themselves before the LORD for battle, and every armed man crosses the Jordan until He has driven His enemies out...

cards.question: If Reuben and Gad do all that and the land is subdued, what does Moses say they get?

answers.text: They may go home and the land is theirs
They get first pick of land in Canaan
They get to lead every tribe in battle

cards.question: Moses tells Reuben and Gad that if they break this promise, nobody will ever know.

cards.text: Moses tells them they'd be sinning against the LORD, and "your sin will find you out." Sin is like cookie crumbs on your apron, friend: you THINK nobody notices, and EVERYBODY notices.

cards.question: Moses tells them to build their cities and folds but do what they promised. How do the Gadites and Reubenites answer?

answers.text: They'll do just as Moses commands
They ask for time to think it over
They offer to send half their men

cards.text: Their children, wives and animals will stay in the cities of Gilead. But every man is equipped for war and will cross over to the battle before the LORD.

cards.question: Moses makes the deal with Reuben and Gad official. Who does he give orders to about them?

answers.text: Eleazar and Joshua and the family leaders
Aaron and Hur and the elders of Israel
Caleb and Phinehas and the tribal judges

cards.text: Moses tells them: if the Gadites and Reubenites cross the Jordan armed for battle and the land is subdued, give them the land of Gilead as a possession.

cards.question: And if the Gadites and Reubenites don't arm up and cross, where does Moses say they get their land?
The Gadites and Reubenites reply that they'll do just as someone has spoken to them. Who do they name?

cards.text: They'll cross into Canaan armed before the LORD, so their inheritance can be on this side of the Jordan. Deal SEALED, friend, and now Moses hands out the land.

cards.question: Moses gives land east of the Jordan to the Gadites, the Reubenites and one more group. Who?

cards.text: Moses gives them the kingdom of Sihon, king of the Amorites, and the kingdom of Og, king of Bashan. The cities, the land and all the territory around them.
The Gadites build up Dibon, Ataroth, Jazer and more as fortified cities, with folds for their flocks. The Reubenites build up Heshbon, Nebo and others, and they rename the cities they rebuild.
The descendants of Machir, son of Manasseh, go to Gilead, capture it and drive out the Amorites who are there.

cards.question: Moses gives Gilead to the clan of Machir son of Manasseh, and they settle there.

cards.text: Jair, a descendant of Manasseh, captures villages and calls them Havvoth-jair. JAIR named the villages after JAIR, friend, and I see what you did there.

cards.question: Then Nobah goes and captures Kenath and its villages. What does he call the place?
